derived_inputs.tidy3d_gold.json: Pole-residue export from tidy3d 2.12.0.dev3 material library; named sphere and reflector gold models.
derived_inputs.tidy3d_permittivity.npz: Complex permittivity sampled by that SDK over 400–700 nm, for independent import checking.
derived_inputs.tidy3d_reflector_snapshot.json: Decoded data-simulation payload in the saved GradientMetasurfaceReflector plot_3d HTML: base64 → gzip → HDF5 JSON_STRING. Original simulation version 2.9.0.
derived_inputs.tidy3d_metasurface.png: Original phase/reflectivity output image extracted from GradientMetasurfaceReflector.ipynb.
derived_inputs.metasurface_digitized.json: Green-line pixel centers in the preceding image; reproducible with metal_reference_checks.py.
derived_inputs.reference_grids.json: Reconstructed locally from saved snapshot using tidy3d==2.9.0; export_metal_reference_grid.py. No server calls.
derived_inputs.reflector_point_epsilon.npz: Tidy3D 2.9.0 client epsilon_on_grid at infinite frequency and actual Ex/Ey/Ez coordinates; central antenna length. No server subpixel operator is represented.
derived_inputs.tidy3d_pml_defaults.json: SDK default PML parameters; saved snapshot also records alpha_max=0.
